sources.title: NHCP historical marker: Cathedral of Naga
sources.note: Supports the facts listed here; historical events do not date the current mapped geometry.

text.en: Bishop Bernardo de la Concepción began construction of the present cathedral in 1808.
The cathedral was finished and blessed in 1843 by Bishop Tomás Ladron de Guevara.
An 1887 earthquake damaged the cathedral; repairs followed in 1890 under Bishop Arsenio Campo and engineer Ricardo Ayuso.
